attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 11
attributes.name: Elemental Mastery
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1d10 to a check by a character at your location to defeat a monster that invokes the Acid, Cold, Electricity, Elemental, Fire, or Poison trait.

Discard this card to add 3 dice to a check by a character at your location to acquire an ally that has the the Acid, Cold, Electricity, Elemental, Fire, or Poison trait.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 13 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.

checks.text: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 11

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Elemental Mastery, add Fire to the list of traits in the second power.
corrections.issue: The first power of Elemental Mastery helps defeat monsters that have any of six elemental traits. The second power helps acquire allies that have any of five elemental traits, leaving out Fire. Is that intentional?
